summary_md:
**[@7zSushi](https://x.com/7zSushi/status/2115059031572398166)** highlights **flint** from RecursiveSI: an Apache-2.0 mixture-of-experts model aimed at coding agents, with ~39.8B total and ~2.5B active parameters.

- RecursiveSI self-reports 74.2% on SWE-bench Verified (the poster explicitly notes this is vendor-reported).
- Hugging Face Transformers added support in v5.21 on Oct 26.
relevance: A permissively licensed ~40B-total / ~2.5B-active agentic coding MoE sits squarely in the mid-size tier that fits comfortably on a Spark.
